</div></section>
<div  class='av-special-heading av-kvidff86-dac9234af51d97d9202c82c9f3387649 av-special-heading-h5 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-15  el_after_av_textblock  el_before_av_textblock '><h5 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Arrival and departure days</h5><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-kvidg9vx-6129156c19ada19abe52516384fdf02f '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>During the high season (15.06. &#8211; 09.09.2026) LOGOS Beach Village accommodations can only be booked by the week, either arriving on Thursdays or Saturdays. If another arrival or departure day is desired, it can be requested and booked for an additional charge*, subject to availability.</p>
<p>*Each empty night in the period 15.06. &#8211; 09.09.2026 will be charged at 50% of the normal price.</p>
